gtang ①du ma mchis pa'i slad du yongs su gzung ②bar bgyi ba'am/ gtang ③bar bgyi ba de lta bu'i chos gang yang des ma dmyigs tedu/ chos thams cad la rlom sems ma mchis pa'i slad du de ni mya ngan las 'das pas kyang rlom sems su 'gyur ba ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar gang chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ gzugs yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang /tshor ba yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / 'du shes yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang /'du byed yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / rnam par shes pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ myig yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / rna ba yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / sna yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / lce yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / lus yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / yid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ gzugs yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / sgra yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / dri yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / ro yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / reg yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang /chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ myig gi rnam par shes pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / rna ba'i rnam par shes pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / sna'i rnam par shes pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / lce'i ⑤rnam par shes pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / lus kyi rnam par shes pa yongs su myi ⑥'dzin pa dang / yid kyi rnam par shes pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang /chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa yongs su myi 15—68

'dzin pa dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang /chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/sa'i khams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chu'i khams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang /mye'i khams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / rlung gi khams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / nam mkha'i khams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / rnam par shes pa'i khams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ ma rig pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / 'du byed yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / rnam par shes pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / mying dang gzugs yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / skye mched drug yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / reg pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / tshor ba yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / sred pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / len pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / srid pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / skye ba yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang /rga shi yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis 15—69

pa'i slad du/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su mi 'dzin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi ①pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ nang stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / phyi stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chen po stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang /chos thams cad stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ yang 15—70

dag par spong ba rnams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ dbang po rnams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ stobs rnams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang /chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ bsam gtan rnams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ tshad myed pa rnams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ rnam par thar pa rnams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ mngon par shes pa rnams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang /15—71

chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ ting nge 'dzin rnams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ myi 'jigs pa bzhi yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ snying rje chen po yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa ba'o brgyad yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang /chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ dgra bcom pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ rang byang chub yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ lam gyi ①rnam pa ⑤shes pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos 15—72

thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ de bzhin nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ①ma mchis pa'i slad du/ma nor ba de bzhin nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid yongs su ②phyi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/chos nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ chos kyi dbyings yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ chos kyi gnas nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/chos skyon myed pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ yang dag pa'i mtha' tsho17yongs su myi 'dzin pa 'di ni/ pha rol ma mchis pa'i pha rol tu phyin pas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'obya//shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa3/ bam po gsum ༅pa/'on kyang smon lam yongs su ma rdzogs kyi bar du bar ma dor yongs su mya ngan las myi 'da' ste/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi yongs su ma rdzogs/ yang dag par spong ba bzhi yongs su ma rdzogs/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi yongs su ma rdzogs/ dbang po lnga yongs su ma rdzogs/ stobs lnga yongs su ma rdzogs/byang chub kyi yan lag bdun yongs su ma rdzogs/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa yongs su ma rdzogs/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi yongs su ma rdzogs/bsam gtan bzhi yongs su ma rdzogs/ tshad myed pa bzhi yongs su ma rdzogs/15—73

gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi yongs su ma rdzogs/ rnam par thar pa brgyad yongs su ma rdzogs/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu yongs su ma rdzogs/ rnam par thar pa'i lasgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa yongs su ma rdzogs/ mngon par shes pa rnams yongs su ma rdzogs/ ting nge 'dzin rnams yongs su ma rdzogs/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams yongs su ma rdzogs/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu yongs su ma rdzogs / myi 'jigs pa bzhi yongs su ma rdzogs/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi yongs su ma rdzogs/② snying rje chen po yongs su ma rdzogs/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad yongs su ma rdzogs kyi bar du bar ma dor yongs su mya ngan las mi 'da'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ 'di ltar smon lam rnams ni smon lam ma lags/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams ni dran pa nye bar gzhag pa ma lags / /yang dag par spong ba rnams ni yang dag par spong ba ma lags/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams ni rdzu 'phrul gyi 0rkang pa ma lags/ /dbang po rnams ni dbang po ma lags/ /stobs rnams ni stobs ma lags/ /byang chub kyi yan lag ④rnams ni byang chub kyi yan lag ma lags/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa ⑤ni 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa ma lags/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams ni 'phags pa'i bden pa ma lags/ /bsam gtan rnams ni bsam gtan ma lags/ /tshad med pa rnams ni tshad med pa ma lags/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug ༅pa rnams ni gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa ma lags/ /rnam par thar pa rnams ni rnam par thar pa ma lags/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu ni mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms 15—74

par 'jug pa ①ma lags/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa ②ni rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa ②ma lags/ /mngon par shes pa rnams ni mngon par shes pa ma lags/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams ni ting nge 'dzin ma lags/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams ni gzungs kyi sgo ma lags/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs ma lags/ /myi 'jigs pa rnams ni myi 'jigs pa ma lags/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams ni/ so so yang dag par rig pa ma lags/ /④snying rje chen po 0ni/snying rje chen po ma lags/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad yini/sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa ma tshulags te'unye/ de dag ni chos kyang ma lags//chos ma lags pa yang ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar 0chos thams cad yongs su ma bzung ba'i slad du/ gzugs yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang /tshor ba yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / 'du shes yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang /'du byed yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / rnam par shes pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su ma bzung ba'i slad du/ myig yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / rna ba yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / sna yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / lce yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / lus yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang /yid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su ma bzung ba'i slad du / gzugs yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / sgra yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang /dri yongs su mi 'dzin pa dang / ro yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / reg yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad 15—75

yongs su ma bzung ba'i slad du/ myig gi rnam par shes pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / rna ba'i rnam par shes pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / sna'i rnam par shes pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / lce'i rnam par shes pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / lus kyi rnam par shes pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / yid kyi rnam par shes pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su ma ①bzung ba'i slad du/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su ma bzung ba'i slad du/myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis khutshor ba yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su ma bzung ba'i slad du/ sa'i khams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chu'i khams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / mye'i khams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / rlung gi khams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / nam mkha'i khams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / rnam par shes pa'i khams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su ma bzung ba'i slad du/ ma rig pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang /15—76

'du byed yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / rnam par shes pa yongs su mi 'dzin pa dang / mying dang gzugs yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / skye mched drug yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / reg pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / tshor ba yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / sred pa yongs su mi 'dzin pa dang / len pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / srid pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / skye ba yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / rga shi yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su ma bzung ba'i slad du/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin ②pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi ②pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su ma bzung ba'i slad du/ nang stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / phyi stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang /phyi nang stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / ②stong pa nyid stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chen po stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang /don dam pa stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang /15—77

rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su ma bzung ba'i slad du/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / yang dag par spong ba rnams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / ①dbang po rnams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / stobs rnams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / byang chub kyi yan lag rnams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa tshos7yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su ma bzung ba'i slad du/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang /bsam gtan rnams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / tshad myed pa rnams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms dupar 'jug pa rnams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / rnam par thar pa brgyad yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / mngon par shes pa rnams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / ting nge 'dzin rnams 0yongs su mi 'dzin pa dang / gzungs kyi sgo rnams yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su ma bzung ba'i ⑤slad du/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / myi 'jigs pa bzhi yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi 15—78

yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang /① snying rje chen po yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su ma bzung ba'i slad du/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang /dgra bcom pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / rang byang chub yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / lam gyi ②rnam pa shes pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su ma bzung ba'i slad du/ de bzhin nyid yongs su mi 'dzin pa dang /ma nor ba de bzhin nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang /chos kyi dbyings yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos kyi gnas nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / chos skyon myed pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin pa dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' yongs su myi 'dzin pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ①ni gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni gang gi/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni ④ci zhig /ci'i phyir ⑤na/ de la 6)shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya zhes yongs su brtag par dubagyi ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ gal te 'di ltar chos gang yod 15—79

pa ma yin zhing myi dmyigs pa de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin nam zhes spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la myi spyod do/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa sha ①ra dwa ti'i bus/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor chos gang rnams myed cing myi dmyigs pa yin/ rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bul/ nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang /'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa myed cing myi dmyigs so//tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang /15—80

mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba skyed pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang /chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang /myi dmigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir gzugs myed cing myi dmyigs ①so/ /tshor ba myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /'du shes myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /'du byed myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rnam par shes pa myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang /chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir/myig myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rna ba myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /sna myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /lce myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /lus myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /yid myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid 15—81

dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba ②skyed pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang /chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir/gzugs myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /sgra myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /dri myed cing myi dmigs so/ /ro myed cing myi dmigs so/ /reg myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /chos myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang /'dus byas stong pa nyid ②dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir/myig gi rnam par shes pa myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /sna'i rnam par shes pa myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /tshe 15—82

dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang /phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang /rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa myed cing myi dmyigs so//rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ nang stong pa nyid dang /phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa ①nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir②/ myig gi 15—83

'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba med cing myi dmyigs so/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /yid ①kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ nang stong pa nyid dang /phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa ②nyid dang /'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang /dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir③/sa'i khams myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /chu'i khams myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /mye'i khams myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rlung gi khams myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /nam mkha'i khams myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ nang stong pa nyid dang /phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid ④dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das 15—84

pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ ma rig pa myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /'du ①byed myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rnam par shes pa myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /mying dang gzugs myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /skye mched drug myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /reg pa myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /tshor ba myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /sred pa myed cing mi dmyigs so/ /len pa myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /srid pa myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /skye ba myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rga shi myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu / nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /bzod pa'i pha rol 15—85

tu phyin pa myed cing myi ①dmyigs ②so/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed cing myi dmyigs so//shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang /don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /dbang po rnams myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /stobs rnams myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ nang stong pa nyid dang /phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las ②'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang /15—86

dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / mi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams ②skyed cing myi dmyigs so/ /bsam gtan rnams myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /tshad myed pa rnams myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug ②pa rnams myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad myed cing sgye dmyigs so/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms ②par 'jug pa dgu myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang smon pa myed pa myed cing myi dmigs so/ /mngon par shes pa rnams myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /myi 'jigs pa rnams myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /④snying rje chen po myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa 15—87

nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /dgra bcom pa nyid myed cing myi dmyigs so//rang byang chub myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /lam gyi ①rnam pa ②shis pa nyid myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid myed cing myi dmyigs so//tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang /phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ②byas stong pa nyid dang /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang /rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa ④nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ de bzhin nyid myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /ma nor ba de bzhin nyid myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /chos nyid myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /chos kyi dbyings myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /chos kyi gnas nyid myed cing myi dmyigs so//chos skyon myed pa nyid 3)myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /yang dag pa'i mtha' myed 15—88

cing myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ nang stong pa nyid dang /phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid ①dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'ang ②skyed cing myi dmyigs so/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'ang ⑤skyed cing myi dmyigs so/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'ang ⑦skyed cing myi dmyigs so/ /dgra bcom pa'ang ⑤skyed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rang sangs rgyas kyang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' yang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /sangs rgyas kyang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ nang medamigs su med pa'i phyir/ nang stong pa nyid myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /phyi ⑦dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ phyi stong pa nyid myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /phyi nang dudamigs su myed pa'i phyir/ phyi nang stong pa nyid myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /chen po stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/chen po stong pa nyid myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ don dam pa stong pa nyid myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /'dus 15—89

byas stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/'dus ma byas stong pa nyid myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dmyigs su med pa'i phyir/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid dmigs su myed pa'i phyir/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid myed cing mi dmyigs so/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid myed cing myi dmyigs so//rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dmigs su myed pa'i phyir/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/gal te de ltar rtog cing sems pa 3)dang / de ltar rtog cing sems pa'i ①tshe/sems zhum pa myed cing yongs su zhum pa myed la/ myi 'jigs myi sngang ②skrag 15—90

par myi 'gyur na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' ①chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ma bral bar shes par bya'o/ /smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor ci'i ②phyir nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ma bral bar shes par bya/ rab 'byor kyis smras pa / tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gzugs ni gzugs kyi rang bzhin dang bral ba ste/ de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /tshor ba ni tshor ba'i rang bzhin dang bral ba ste/ de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /'du shes ni 'du shes kyi rang bzhin dang bral ba ste/ de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin tu rab tu shes so/ /'du byed ni 'du byed kyi rang bzhin dang bral ba ste/ de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /rnam par shes pa ni rnam par shes pa'i rang bzhin dang bral ba ste/ de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ myig ni myig gi rang bzhin dang bral ba ste/ de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /rna ba ni rna ba'i rang bzhin dang bral ba ste/ de byang chub sems dpa' sems 15—91

dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /sna ni sna'i rang bzhin dang bral ba ste/ de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe / yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /lce ni lce'i rang bzhin dang bral ba ste/ de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /lus ni lus kyi rang bzhin dang bral ba ste/ de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /yid ni yid kyi rang bzhin dang bral ba ste/ de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gzugs ni gzugs kyi rang bzhin dang bral ba ste/ de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe / yang dag pa ji lta ba hu)bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /sgra ni sgra'i rang bzhin dang bral ba ste/ de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /dri ni dri'i rang bzhin dang bral ba ste/ de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /ro ni ro'i rang bzhin dang bral ba ste/ de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe / yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /reg ni reg gi ②rang 15—92

bzhin dang bral ba ste/ de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /chos ni chos kyi rang bzhin dang bral ba ste/ de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/myig gi rnam par shes pa ni/ myig gi rnam par shes pa'i rang bzhin dang bral ba ste / de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa ni/ rna ba'i rnam par shes pa'i rang bzhin dang bral ba ste/de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /sna'i rnam par shes pa ni/ sna'i rnam par shes pa'i rang bzhin dang bral ba ste/ de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa ni lce'i rnam par shes pa'i rang bzhin dang bral ba ste/ de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa ni lus kyi rnam par shes pa'i rang bzhin dang bral ba ste/ de byang chub sems dpa' sems da pa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa ni/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i rang bzhin dang bral ba ste/ de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' 15—93
