nyid stong pa nyid dang / mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir yod pa ma yin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ dbang po rnams nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir yod pa ma yin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ stobs rnams nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang /chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang /mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir yod pa ma yin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams nang stong pa 15—438

nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang /'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang /dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir yod pa ma yin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ 'phags pa'i ①lam yan lag brgyad pa ②nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir yod pa ma ②yin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas 15—439

stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ①ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong ②pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir yod pa ma yin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ bsam gtan rnams nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir yod pa ma yin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ tshad med pa rnams nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa 15—440

nyid dang / mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir yod pa ma yin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gzugs med pa'i snyoms ①par 'jug pa rnams nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang /don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir yod pa ma yin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam par thar pa brgyad nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir yod pa ma yin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ mthar kyis gnas 15—441

pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang /phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang /thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang /rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir yod pa ma yin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba ①med pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir yod pa ma yin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ mngon par shes pa rnams nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong 15—442

pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa ①nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir yod pa ma yin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ ting nge 'dzin rnams nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang /chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang /mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir yod pa ma yin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams nang stong pa nyid dang /phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad 15—443

stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir yod pa ma yin no//sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu nang stong pa nyid dang /phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir yod pa ma yin no//sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang ②/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid dang /dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir yod pa ma yin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/15—444

so so yang dag par rig pa bzhil/ nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang (snye/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa dustong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid dang /dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir yod pa ma yin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/snying rje chen po nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang /don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas ④stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir yod pa ma yin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang /phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang /15—445

'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang /thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang /rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir yod pa ma yin no/ /de la byis pa so so'i skye bo ①rnams med pa la mngon par zhen pas/ srid pa la mngon par zhen te/ de dag gis med pasno/ yongs su brtags pas/ med pa la mngon par zhen cing /'di lta ste/ chad pa dang / rtag pa'i mtha' gnyis dul chags pas de dag mi shes mi mthong ste/ gang med pa'i chos de dag yongs su brtags nas/ ming dang gzugs la mngon par zhen pa de dag /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la mngon par zhen to/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mngon par zhen to/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la mngon par zhen to/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mngon par zhen to/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mngon par zhen to/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mngon par zhen to/ /nang stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen to/ /phyi stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen to/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen to/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen to/ /chen po stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen to/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen to/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen to/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen to/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen to/ /thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid la mngon 15—446

par zhen to/ /dor ba med pa stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen to/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen to/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen to/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen ༅to/ /mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen to/ /dngos po med pa stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen to/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen to/ /dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen to/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag ②pa rnams la mngon par zhen to/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams la mngon par zhen to/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams la mngon par zhen to/ /dbang po rnams la mngon par zhen to/ /stobs rnams la mngon par zhen to/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams la mngon par zhen to/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa la mngon par zhen to/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams la mngon par zhen to/ /bsam gtan rnams la mngon par zhen to/ /tshad med pa rnams la mngon par zhen to/ /gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la mngon par zhen to/ /rnam par thar pa rnams la mngon par zhen to/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams (snyel mngon par zhen to/ / rnam par thar pa'i sgo dustong pa nyid dang mtshan ma myed pa dang smon pa myed pa la mngon par zhen to/ /mngon par shes pa rnams la mngon par zhen to/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams la mngon par zhen to/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams la mngon par zhen to/ /0de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams la mngon par zhen to/ /mi 'jigs pa rnams la mngon par zhen to/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams la mngon par zhen to/ / snying rje chen po la mngon par zhen to/ /gyesangs rgyas 15—447

kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams ①la/ mngon par zhen to/ /de dag de ltar mngon par zhen pas/ yod pa ma yin pa'i chos rnams la yongs su rtog ste/ de dag mi shes mi mthong ngo / /ci mi shes mi mthong zhe na/ gzugs mi shes mi mthong ngo / /tshor ba mi shes mi mthong ngo / /'du shes myi shes mi mthong ngo 'du byed mi shes mi mthong ngo / /rnam par shes pa mi shes mi mthong ngo / /mig mi shes mi mthong ngo / /rna ba mi shes mi mthong ngo / /sna mi shes mi mthong ngo / /lce mi shes mi mthong ngo / /lus myi shes myi mthong ngo / /yid mi shes mi mthong ngo / /gzugs mi shes mi mthong ngo / /sgra mi shes mi mthong ngo / /dri mi shes mi mthong ngo / /ro mi shes mi mthong ngo / /reg mi shes mi mthong ngo chos mi shes mi mthong ngo / /myig gi rnam par shes pa myi shes myi mthong ngo rna ba'i rnam par shes pa mi shes mi mthong ngo / /sna'i rnam par shes pa mi shes mi mthong ngo / /lce'i rnam par shes pa mi shes mi mthong ngo / /lus kyi rnam par shes pa mi shes mi mthong ngo / /yid kyi rnam par shes pa mi shes mi mthong ngo / /mig gi 'dus te reg pa mi shes mi mthong ngo / /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa mi shes mi mthong ngo / /sna'i 'dus te reg pa mi shes mi mthong ngo / /rtse'i 'dus te reg pa mi shes mi mthong ngo / /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa mi shes mi mthong ngo / /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa mi shes mi mthong ngo / /mig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis zhutshor ba mi shes mi mthong ngo / /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba mi shes mi mthong ngo / /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba mi shes mi mthong ngo / /lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba mi shes mi mthong ngo / /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba mi shes mi mthong ngo / /yid kyi 15—448

'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba mi shes mi mthong ngo / / sa'i khams mi shes mi mthong ngo / /chu'i khams mi shes mi mthong ngo / /me'i khams mi shes mi mthong ngo / /rlung gi khams mi shes mi mthong ngo / /nam mkha'i khams mi shes mi mthong ngo / /rnam par shes pa'i khams mi shes mi mthong ngo / /ma rig pa mi shes mi mthong ngo / /'du byed mi shes mi mthong ngo / /rnam par shes pa mi shes mi mthong ngo / /ming dang gzugs mi shes mi mthong ngo / /skye mched drug mi shes mi mthong ngo / /reg pa mi shes mi mthong ngo / /tshor ba mi shes mi mthong ngo / /sred pa mi shes mi mthong ngo / /len pa mi shes mi mthong ngo / /srid pa mi shes mi mthong ngo / /skye ba mi shes mi mthong ngo / /rga shi mi shes mi mthong ngo / /①sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa mi shes mi mthong ngo / /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mi shes mi mthong ngo / /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa mi shes mi mthong ngo / /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mi shes mi mthong ngo /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa mi shes mi mthong ngo / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mi shes mi mthong ngo / /nang stong pa nyid mi shes mi mthong ngo / /phyi stong pa nyid mi shes mi mthong ngo / /phyi nang stong pa nyid mi shes mi mthong ngo / /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid mi shes mi mthong ngo / /chen po stong pa nyid mi shes mi mthong ngo / /don dam pa stong pa nyid mi shes mi mthong ngo / /'dus byas stong pa nyid mi shes mi mthong ngo / /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid mi shes mi mthong ngo / /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid mi shes mi mthong ngo / /thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid mi shes mi mthong ngo / /dor ba med pa stong pa nyid mi shes mi mthong ngo / /rang bzhin stong pa nyid mi shes mi mthong ngo chos thams cad 15—449

stong pa nyid mi shes mi mthong ngo / /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid mi shes mi mthong ngo / /mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid mi shes mi mthong ngo / /dngos po med pa stong pa nyid mi shes mi mthong ngo / /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid mi shes mi mthong ngo / /dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid mi shes mi mthong ngo / /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi mi shes mi mthong ngo / /yang dag par spong ba bzhi mi shes mi mthong ngo / /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi mi shes mi mthong ngo / /dbang po lnga mi shes mi mthong ngo / /stobs lnga mi shes mi mthong ngo / /byang chub kyi yan lag bdun mi shes mi mthong ngo / /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa mi shes mi mthong ngo / /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams mi shes mi mthong ngo / /bsam gtan rnams mi shes mi mthong ngo / /tshad med pa rnams mi shes mi mthong ngo / /gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi mi shes mi mthong ngo / /rnam par thar pa brgyad mi shes mi mthong ngo / /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu mi shes mi mthong ngo / /stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa mi shes mi mthong ngo / /mngon par shes pa rnams mi shes mi mthong ngo / /ting nge 'dzin rnams mi shes mi mthong ngo / /gzungs kyi sgo rnams mi shes mi mthong ngo / /①de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu myi shes myi mthong ngo / /myi 'jigs pa bzhi myi shes myi mthong ngo / /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi lamyi shes myi mthong ngo / / snying rje chen po myi shes myi mthong ngo ③sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams myi shes myi mthong ngo / /de ltar de dag ni byis pa zhes bya ba'i grangs su 'dong ba ste/ de dag du'abyung ba ma ⑤yin no/ /gang nas 'byung ba ma yin zhe na/ 'dod pa'i khams nas 'byung ba ma yin no/ /15—450

gzugs kyi khams nas 'byung ba ma yin no/ /gzugs med pa'i khams nas 'byung ba ma yin no/ /nyan thos kyi sa nas 'byung ba ma yin no/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi sa nas 'byung ba ma yin no/ /de dag ni yid mi ches pa ste/ ji ltar yid mi ches zhe ①na/ gzugs gzugs kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /tshor ba tshor bas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /'du shes 'du shes kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /'du byed 'du byed kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /rnam par shes pa rnam par shes pas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /mig mig gis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /rna ba rna bas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /sna snas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so rtse lces stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /lus lus kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /yid yid kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /gzugs gzugs kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /sgra sgras stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so//dri dris stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /ro ros stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ / reg reg ②gis stong zhes ⑧bya bar yid mi ches so/ /chos chos kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /mig gi ④rnam par shes pa mig gi rnam par shes pas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa rna ba'i rnam par shes pas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /sna'i rnam par shes pa sna'i rnam par shes pas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa lce'i rnam par shes pas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa lus kyi durnam par shes pas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa yid kyi rnam par shes pas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so /15—451

mig gi ②'dus te reg ②pa mig gi 'dus te reg pas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa rna ba'i 'dus te reg pas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa sna'i 'dus te reg pas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa lce'i 'dus te reg pas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa lus kyi du'adus te reg pas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa yid kyi 'dus te reg pas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /mig gi 'dus te reg pa'i ༅rkyen kyis tshor ba mig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i 0rkyen kyis tshor ba rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i ༅rkyen kyis tshor bas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /rtse'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ / sa'i khams sa'i khams kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /chu'i khams chu'i khams kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /me'i khams me'i khams kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /rlung gi khams rlung gi khams kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /nam mkha'i khams nam mkha'i khams kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams rnam par shes pa'i 15—452

khams kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /ma rig pa ma rig pas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /'du byed 'du byed kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /rnam par shes pa rnam par shes pas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /ming dang gzugs ming dang gzugs kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so skye mched drug skye mched drug gis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /reg pa reg pas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /tshor ba tshor bas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /sred pa sred pas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /len pa len pas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /srid pa srid pas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /skye ba skye bas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /rga shi rga shis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /①sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ②brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /nang stong pa nyid nang stong pa nyid kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /phyi stong pa nyid phyi stong pa ③nyid kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid phyi nang stong pa nyid kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi 15—453

ches so/ /chen po stong pa nyid chen po stong pa nyid kyis ②stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid don dam pa stong pa nyid kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid mtha' las ②'das pa stong pa nyid kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dor ba med pa stong pa nyid kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid ②kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dngos po med pa stong pa nyid kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /yang dag par spong ba bzhi yang dag par spong ba rnams kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /15—454

dbang po lnga dbang po rnams kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /stobs lnga stobs rnams ①kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ / zobyang chub kyi yan lag bdun byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyis ②stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /ma(gyi'aphags pa'i bden pa rnams 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /bsam gtan rnams bsam gtan rnams kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /tshad med pa rnams tshad med pa rnams kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams/ gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad rnam par thar pa brgyad kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgus stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang /mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pas stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so /mngon par shes pa rnams mngon par shes pa rnams kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams ting nge 'dzin rnams kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcus stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /mi 'jigs pa bzhi mi 'jigs pa bzhis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi so 15—455

so yang dag par rig pa bzhis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /snying rje chen po snying rje chen pos stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bus stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bus stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bus stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /dgra bcom pa nyid dgra bcom pa nyid kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /rang byang chub rang byang chub kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches sol/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyis stong zhes bya bar yid mi ches so/ /de dag ni ①gnas pa ma yin pa ste/ ji ltar gnas pa ma yin zhe na/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas pa ma yin/tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas pa ma yin/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas pa ma yin/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas pa ma yin / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas pa ma yin/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la ②gnas pa ma yin/ nang stong pa nyid la gnas pa ma yin/phyi stong pa nyid la gnas pa ma yin/ phyi nang stong pa nyid ①la gnas pa ma yin/stong pa nyid stong pa nyid la gnas pa ma yin/ chen po stong pa nyid la gnas pa ma yin/ don dam pa stong pa nyid la gnas pa ma yin/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid la gnas pa ma yin/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid la gnas pa ma yinadu/15—456

mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid la gnas pa ma yin/ thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid la gnas pa ma yin/ dor ba med pa stong pa nyid la gnas pa ma yin/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid la gnas pa ma yin/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid la gnas pa ma yin/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid la gnas pa ma yin/mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid la gnas pa ma yin/ dngos po med pa stong pa nyid la gnas pa ma yin/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la gnas pa ma yin/ dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la gnas pa ma yin/ phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la gnas pa ma yin/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams la gnas pa ma yin/yang dag par spong ba rnams la gnas pa ma yin/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams la gnas pa ma yin/ dbang po rnams la gnas pa ma yin/ stobs rnams la gnas pa ma yin/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams la gnas pa ma yin/'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa la gnas pa ma yin/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams la gnas pa ma yin/ bsam gtan rnams la ①gnas pa ma yin/tshad med pa rnams la gnas pa ma yin/ gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la gnas pa ma yin/ rnam par thar pa brgyad la gnas pa ma yin/mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu la gnas pa ma yin/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa ②la gnas pa ma yin/ mngon par shes pa rnams la gnas pa ma yin/ ting nge 'dzin rnams la gnas pa ma yin/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams la gnas pa ma yin/de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu la gnas pa ma yin/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi la gnas pa ma yin/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi la gnas pa ma yin/15—457

byams pa chen po la gnas pa ma ①yin/ snying rje chen po la gnas pa ma yin/sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams la gnas pa ma yin no/ /de dag ni mngon par zhen pa yin te/ ji ltar mngon par zhen pa yin zhe na/ gzugs la mngon par zhen pa yin/ tshor ba la mngon par zhen pa yin/ 'du shes la mngon par zhen pa yin/ 'du byed la mngon par zhen ②pa yin/ rnam par shes pa la mngon par zhen pa yin/ mig la mngon par zhen pa yin/ rna ba la mngon par zhen pa yin/ sna la mngon par zhen pa yin/ lce la mngon par zhen pa yin/ lus la mngon par zhen pa yin/ yid la mngon par zhen pa yin / gzugs la mngon par zhen pa yin/ sgra la mngon par zhen pa yin/dri la mngon par zhen pa yin/ ro la mngon par zhen pa yin/ reg la mngon par zhen pa yin/ chos la mngon par zhen skyepa yin/ mig gi khams la mngon par zhen pa yin/ gzugs kyi khams la mngon par zhen pa yin/mig gi rnam par shes pa'i khams la/ mngon par zhen pa yin/ rna ba'i khams la mngon par zhen pa yin/ sgra'i khams la mngon par zhen pa yin/rna ba'i rnam par shes pa'i khams la mngon par zhen pa yin/ sna'i khams la mngon par zhen pa yin/ dri'i khams la mngon par zhen pa yin/ sna'i rnam par shes pa'i khams la mngon par zhen pa yin/ lce'i khams la mngon par zhen pa yin/ ro'i khams la mngon par zhen pa yin/ lce'i rnam par shes pa'i khams la mngon par zhen pa yin/ lus kyi khams la mngon par zhen pa yin / reg bya'i khams la mngon par zhen pa yin/ lus kyi rnam par shes pa'i khams la mngon par zhen pa yin/ yid kyi khams la mngon par zhen pa 15—458

yin / chos kyi khams la mngon par zhen pa yin/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i khams la mngon par zhen pa yin/ 'dod chags la mngon par zhen pa yin/zhe snang la mngon par zhen pa yin/ gti mug la mngon par zhen pa yin/ lta ba'i rnam pa la mngon par zhen pa yin/ ma rig pa la mngon par zhen pa yin/'du byed la mngon par zhen pa yin/ rnam par shes pa la mngon par zhen pa yin / ming dang gzugs la mngon par zhen pa yin/ skye mched drug la mngon par zhen pa yin/ reg pa la mngon par zhen pa yin/ tshor ba la mngon par zhen pa yin/ sred pa la mngon par zhen pa yin/ len pa la mngon par zhen pa yin/ srid pa la mngon par zhen pa yin/ skye ba la mngon par zhen pa yin/ rga shi la mngon par zhen pa yin/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la mngon par zhen pa yin/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mngon par zhen pa yin/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la mngon par zhen pa yin/brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mngon par zhen pa yin/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mngon par zhen pa yin/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mngon par zhen pa yin/ nang stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen pa yin/ phyi stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen pa yin/ phyi nang stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen pa yin/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen pa yin/ chen po stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen pa yin/ don dam pa stong pa nyid la mngon par ①zhen pa yin/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen pa yin/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen pa yin/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen pa yin/ thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid la mngon 15—459

par zhen pa yin/ dor ba med pa stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen pa yin/rang bzhin stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen pa yin/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen pa yin/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen pa yin/ mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen pa yin/ dngos po med pa stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen pa yin/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen pa yin/ dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen pa yin/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams la mngon par zhen pa yin/yang dag par spong ba rnams la mngon par zhen pa yin/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams la mngon par zhen pa yin/ dbang po rnams la mngon par zhen pa yin/stobs rnams la mngon par zhen pa yin/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams la mngon par zhen pa yin/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa la mngon par zhen pa yin/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams la mngon par zhen pa yin/bsam gtan rnams la mngon par zhen pa yin/ tshad med pa rnams la mngon par zhen pa yin/ gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la mngon par zhen pa yin/ rnam par thar pa brgyad la mngon par zhen pa yin/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu la mngon par zhen pa yin/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa la mngon par zhen pa yin/ mngon par shes pa rnams la mngon par zhen pa yin / ting nge 'dzin rnams la mngon par zhen pa yin/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams la mngon par zhen pa yin/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu la mngon par zhen pa yin/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi la mngon par zhen pa yin/ so so yang 15—460

dag par rig ①pa bzhi la mngon par zhen pa yin/ byams ②pa chen po la mngon par zhen pa yin/ snying rje chen po la mngon par zhen pa yin/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad la mngon par zhen pa yin/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu la mngon par zhen pa yin/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la mngon par zhen pa yin/ phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la mngon par zhen pa yin / dgra bcom pa nyid la mngon par zhen pa yin/ rang byang chub la mngon par zhen pa yin/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid la mngon par zhen pa yin/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la mngon par zhen pa yin/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la mngon par zhen pa yin te/ de'i phyir na ②byis pa zhes bya'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mi ༅slob cing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du mi 'byung ba lags sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑤bka' stsal pa/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mi slob pa yin/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du mi 'byung ba yinayi/ gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das ci'i slad du/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mi slob pa lags/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du mi 'byung ba lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ 'di la ④byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ thabs mi mkhas pas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la brtags shing mngon par zhen/bsam gtan gyi nipha rol tu phyin pa la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ brtson 15—461

'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ nang stong pa nyid la brtags shing mngon par zhen/phyi stong pa nyid la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ phyi nang stong pa nyid la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid la brtags ①shing mngon par zhen/ chen po stong pa nyid la brtags ②shing mngon par zhen/don dam pa stong pa nyid la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid la brtags shing mngon par zhen / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ mi dmigs pa ③ stong pa nyid la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ dngos po med pa stong pa nyid la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ yang dag par spong ba rnams la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ dbang po rnams la brtags shing ④mngon par zhen/15—462

stobs rnams la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ bsam gtan rnams la brtags shing mngon par zhen/tshad med pa rnams la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ rnam par thar pa brgyad la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang /mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa la brtags shing mngon par zhen/mngon par shes pa rnams la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ ting nge 'dzin rnams la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ snying rje chen po la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bca brgyad la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ thams cad shes pa nyid la brtags shing mngon par zhen/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid la brtags shing mngon par zhen/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la brtags shing mngon par zhen pas/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mi slob pa yin/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du mi 'byung ba yin no/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de lta lags na/15—463

byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rnam pa gang gis slob par 'gyur ba lags/ ji ltar bslabs ①na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung ba lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu nam ②byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa de mi dmigs②/ yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste④/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis 'byung ba yin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa de mi dmigs shing / yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar slob pa ni/ mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung ngo / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa de mi dmigs shing yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab ⑤kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar slob pa ni/ mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung ngo / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa de mi dmigs shing ⑥/ yang dag 15—464

par rjes su mi mthong ste/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ①ltar slob pa ni/ mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen ②pa nyid du 'byung ngo / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa de mi dmigs shing yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar slob pa ni/ mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung ngo / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ sbyin pa'i ①pa rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa de mi dmigs shing / yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar slob pa ni/ mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung ngo // //shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po bcu drug dupa/sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ nang stong pa nyid la spyod pa'i tshe/ nang stong pa nyid de mi dmigs shing / yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar slob pa ni/ mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung ngo / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ phyi stong pa 15wa 465

nyid la spyod pa'i tshe/ phyi stong pa nyid/ de mi dmigs shing yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar slob pa ni/ mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis①/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung ngo / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ phyi nang stong pa nyid la spyod pa'i tshe/② phyi nang stong pa nyid de mi dmigs shing / yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar slob pa ni/ mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung ngo / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid la spyod pa'i tshe/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid de mi dmigs shing /yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste / sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar slob pa ni/mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung ngo / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ chen po stong pa nyid la spyod pa'i tshe/ chen po stong pa nyid de mi dmigs shing / yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar slob pa ni/ mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung ngo / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ don dam pa stong pa nyid la spyod pa'i tshe/ don dam pa stong pa ④nyid de mi dmigs shing /15—466

yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar slob pa ni/mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung ngo / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid la spyod pa'i tshe/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid de mi dmigs shing /yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar slob pa ni/mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung ngo / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid la spyod pa'i tshe/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid de mi dmigs shing yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar slob pa ni/ mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung ngo / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid la spyod pa'i tshe/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid de mi dmigs shing yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar slob pa ni/ mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung ngo / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid la spyod pa'i tshe/ thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid de mi dmigs shing yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/15—467

sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar slob pa ni/ mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung ngo / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dor ba med pa stong pa nyid la spyod pa'i tshe/dor ba med pa stong pa nyid de mi dmigs shing / yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar slob pa ni/ mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung ngo / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid la spyod pa'i tshe/rang bzhin stong pa nyid de mi dmigs shing / yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar slob pa ni/ mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung ngo / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid la spyod pa'i tshe/chos thams cad stong pa nyid de mi dmigs shing / yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar slob pa ni/ mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung ngo / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid la spyod pa'i tshe/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid de mi dmigs shing yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen 15—468

tu phyin pa la de ltar slob pa ni/ mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung ngo / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams la spyod pa'i tshe/dran pa nye bar gzhag pa de dag mi dmigs shing / yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar slob pa ni/ mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung ngo / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ yang dag par spong ba rnams la spyod pa'i tshe/ yang dag par spong ba de dag mi dmigs shing / yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar slob pa ni/ mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung ngo / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams la spyod pa'i tshe/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa de dag mi dmigs shing / yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar slob pa ni/ mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung ngo / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ dbang po rnams la spyod pa'i tshe/ dbang po de dag mi dmigs shing / yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar slob pa ni/ mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis/15—470

rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung ngo / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ stobs rnams la spyod pa'i tshe/stobs de dag mi dmigs shing / yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar slob pa ni/ mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung ngo / /①sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ byang chub kyi yan ②lag rnams la spyod pa'i tshe/byang chub kyi yan ②lag de dag mi dmigs shing / yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar slob pa ni/ mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung ngo / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ 'phags pa'i lam yan ④lag brgyad pa de dag mi dmigs shing /yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar slob pa ni/mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung ngo / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams la spyod pa'i tshe/ 'phags pa'i bden pa de dag mi dmigs shing / yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar slob pa ni/ mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa 15—471

nyid du 'byung ngo / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ bsam gtan rnams la spyod pa'i tshe/ bsam gtan de dag mi dmigs shing / yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar slob pa ni/ mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung ngo / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/tshad med pa rnams la spyod pa'i tshe/ tshad med pa de dag mi dmigs shing /yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar slob pa ni/mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung ngo / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la spyod pa'i tshe/ gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa de dag mi dmigs shing / yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar slob pa ni/ mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung ngo / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ rnam par ①thar pa rnams la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam par thar pa ②de dag mi dmigs shing / yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar slob pa ni/ mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung ngo / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems 15—472

dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu la spyod pa'i tshe/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu po de dag mi dmigs shing / yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar slob pa ni/ mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung ngo / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang /smon pa med pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang /mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa de dag ①mi dmigs shing / yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar slob pa ni/ mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung ngo / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ mngon par shes pa rnams la spyod pa'i tshe/ mngon par shes pa de dag mi dmigs shing /yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar slob pa ni/mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung ngo / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ ting nge 'dzin rnams la spyod pa'i tshe/ ting nge 'dzin de dag mi dmigs shing / yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar slob pa ni/15—473

mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung ngo / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams la spyod pa'i tshe/ gzungs kyi sgo de dag mi dmigs shing yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar slob pa ni/ mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung ngo / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyustobs bcu la spyod pa'i tshe/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu po de dag mi dmigs shing / yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar slob pa ni/ mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung ngo / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/mi 'jigs pa bzhi la spyod pa'i tshe/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi po de dag mi dmigs shing / yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar slob pa ni/ mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung ngo / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi la spyod pa'i tshe/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi po de dag mi dmigs shing / yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar slob pa ni/ mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rnam pa thams 15—474

cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung ngo / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ snying rje chen po la spyod pa'i tshe/ snying rje chen po de ①mi dmigs shing / yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar slob pa ni/ mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung ngo / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams la spyod pa'i tshe/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa de dag mi dmigs shing / yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar slob pa ni/ mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung ngo / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ thams cad shes pa nyid la spyod pa'i tshe/thams cad shes pa nyid de mi dmigs shing / yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar slob pa ni/ mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung ngo / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid la spyod pa'i tshe/lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid de mi dmigs shing / yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar slob pa ni/ mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung ngo / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub 15—475

sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid de mi dmigs shing / yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar slob pa ni/ mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung ngo / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa dang / de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la slob pa ni/ mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung ngo / /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gang mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung ba lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu/hu) nang stong pa nyid mi dmigs pa'i tshul dang / phyi stong pa nyid mi dmigs pa'i tshul dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid mi dmigs pa'i tshul dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid mi dmigs pa'i tshul dang / chen po stong pa nyid mi dmigs pa'i tshul dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid mi dmigs pa'i tshul dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid mi dmigs pa'i tshul dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid mi dmigs pa'i tshul dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid mi dmigs pa'i tshul dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid mi dmigs pa'i tshul dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid mi dmigs pa'i tshul dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid mi dmigs pa'i tshul dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid mi dmigs pa'i tshul dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid mi dmigs pa'i tshul dang / mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid mi dmigs pa'i 15—476

tshul dang / dngos po med pa stong pa nyid mi dmigs pa'i tshul dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid mi dmigs pa'i tshul dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar shes par bya'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa las/ le'u drug go①// //de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis/ bcom ldana'adas la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das la la zhig ②'di skad du 'dri zhing / ci sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bslabs shing ②/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ram/ zhes mchis ④na/ bcom ldan 'das de skad du du'adri ba ⑥de la/ ji skad du bstan par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das la la zhig 'di skad du 'dri zhing / ci sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bslabs shing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ram zhes mchi na/ bcom ldan 'das de skad du 'dri ba de la ji skad du bstan par bgyi/bcom ldan 'das la la zhig 'di skad du 'dri zhing / ci sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di/brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bslabs shing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ram zhes mchi na/ bcom ldan 'das de skad du 'dri ba de la ji skad du bstan par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das la la zhig 'di skad du 'dri zhing /15—477

ci sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la bslabs shing /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ram zhes mchi na/ bcom ldan 'das de skad du 'dri ba de la ji skad du bstan par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das la la zhig 'di skad du 'dri zhing / ci sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bslabs shing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ram zhes mchi na/bcom ldan 'das de skad du 'dri ba de la ji skad du bstan par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das la la zhig 'di skad du hu)'dri zhing / ci sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la bslabs shing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ram zhes mchi na/ bcom ldan 'das de skad du 'dri ba de la ji skad du bstan par bgyi / bcom ldan 'das la la zhig 'di skad du 'dri zhing / ci sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di/ nang stong pa nyid la bslabs shing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob ②par 'gyur ram zhes mchi na/ bcom ldan 'das de skad du 'dri ba de la ji skad du bstan par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das la la zhig 'di skad du 'dri zhing / ci sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di/ phyi stong pa nyid la bslabs shing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ram zhes mchi na/ bcom ldan 'das de skad du 'dri ba de la ji skad du bstan par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das la la zhig 'di skad du 'dri zhing ①/15—478

ci sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di/ phyi nang stong pa nyid la bslabs shing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ram zhes mchi na/ bcom ldan 'das de skad du ②'dri ba de la ji skad du bstan par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das la la zhig 'di skad du 'dri zhing / ci sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di stong pa nyid stong pa nyid la bslabs shing /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ram zhes mchi na/ bcom ldan 'das de skad du 'dri ba de la ji skad du bstan par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das la la zhig 'di skad du 'dri zhing ②/ ci sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di/ chen po stong pa nyid la bslabs shing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ram zhes mchi na/ bcom ldan 'das de skad du 'dri ba de la ji skad du bstan par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das la la zhig 'di skad du 'dri zhing / ci sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di/ don dam pa stong pa ①nyid la bslabs shing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ram zhes mchi na/ bcom ldan 'das de skad du 'dri ba de la ji skad du bstan par bgyi / bcom ldan 'das la la zhig 'di skad du 'dri zhing / ci sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid la bslabs shing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen ④pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ram zhes mchi na/ bcom ldan 'das de skad du 'dri ba de la ji skad du bstan par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das la la zhig 'di skad du 'dri zhing /15—479

ci sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid la bslabs shing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob nyu)par 'gyur ram/ zhes mchi na/ bcom ldan 'das de skad du 'dri ba de la ji skad du bstan par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das la la zhig 'di skad du 'dri zhing / ci sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid la bslabs shing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ram zhes mchi na/bcom ldan 'das de skad du 'dri ba de la ji skad du bstan par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das la la zhig 'di skad du 'dri zhing / ci sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di/ thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid la bslabs shing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ram zhes mchi na/ bcom ldan 'das de skad du 'dri ba de la ji skad du bstan par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das la la zhig 'di skad du 'dri zhing / ci sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di/ dor ba med pa stong pa nyid la bslabs shing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ram zhes mchi na/ bcom ldan 'das de skad du 'dri ba de la ji skad du bstan par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das la la zhig 'di skad du 'dri zhing / ci sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid la bslabs shing /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ram zhes mchi na/ bcom ldan 'das de skad du 'dri ba de la ji skad du bstan par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das la la zhig 15—480

'di skad du 'dri zhing / ci sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di chos thams cad stong pa nyid la bslabs shing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ram/ zhes mchi na/bcom ldan 'das de skad du 'dri ba de la ji skad du bstan par bgyilha/ bcom ldan 'das la la zhig 'di skad du 'dri zhing / ci sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid la bslabs shing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur lduram/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ram zhes mchi na/ bcom ldan 'das de skad du 'dri ba de la ji skad du bstan par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das la la zhig 'di skad du 'dri zhing / ci sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid la bslabs shing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur nuram/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa ④nyid thob par 'gyur ram zhes mchi na/ bcom ldan 'das de skad du 'dri ba de la ji skad du bstan par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das la la zhig 'di skad du 'dri zhing / ci sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di/ dngos po med pa stong pa 'unyid la bslabs shing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ⑥ram / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur skyeram zhes mchi na/bcom ldan 'das de skad du 'dri ba de la ji skad du bstan par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das la la zhig 'di skad du 'dri zhing / ci sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la bslabs shing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur duram/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ⑨ram zhes mchi na/ bcom ldan 'das de skad du 'dri ba de la ji skad du bstan 15—481

par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das la la zhig 'di skad du 'dri zhing / ci sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di/ dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la bslabs shing /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob nyapar 'gyur ram zhes mchi na/ bcom ldan 'das de skad du 'dri ba de la ji skad du bstan par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das la la zhig 'di skad du 'dri zhing / ci sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams la bslabs shing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob ②par 'gyur ram zhes mchi na / bcom ldan 'das de skad du 'dri ba de la ji skad du bstan par bgyi/bcom ldan 'das la la zhig 'di skad du 'dri zhing / ci sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di/yang dag par spong ba rnams la bslabs shing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ram zhes mchi na/ bcom ldan 'das de skad du 'dri ba de la ji skad du bstan par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das la la zhig 'di skad du 'dri zhing / ci sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams la bslabs shing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ram zhes mchi na/ bcom ldan 'das de skad du 'dri ba de la ji skad du bstan par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das la la zhig 'di skad du 'dri zhing / ci sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di/ dbang po rnams la bslabs shing /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ram zhes mchi na/ bcom ldan 'das de 15—482

skad du 'dri ba de la ji skad du bstan par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das la la zhig 'di skad du 'dri zhing / ci sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di/ stobs rnams la bslabs shing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ram zhes mchi na/ bcom ldan 'das de skad du 'dri ba de la ji skad du bstan par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das la la zhig 'di skad du 'dri zhing / ci 7sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams la bslabs shing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ram zhes mchi na/ bcom ldan 'das de skad du 'dri ba de la ji skad du bstan par bgyi/bcom ldan 'das la la zhig 'di skad du 'dri zhing / ci sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di/'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa la bslabs shing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ram zhes mchici na/ bcom ldan 'das de skad du 'dri ba de la ji skad du bstan par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das la la zhig 'di skad du 'dri zhing /ci sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams la bslabs shing /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ram zhes mchi na/ bcom ldan 'das de skad du 'dri ba de la ji skad du bstan par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das la la zhig 'di skad du 'dri zhing / ci sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di/ bsam gtan rnams la bslabs shing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ram zhes mchi na/ bcom 15—483

ldan 'das de skad du 'dri ba de la ji skad du bstan par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das la la zhig 'di skad du 'dri zhing / ci sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di tshad med pa rnams la bslabs shing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ram zhes mchi na / bcom ldan 'das de skad du 'dri ba de la ji skad du bstan par bgyi/bcom ldan 'das la la zhig 'di skad du 'dri zhing / ci sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di/gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la bslabs shing ①/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ram/ zhes mchi na/ bcom ldan 'das de skad du 'dri ba de la ji skad du bstan par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das la la zhig 'di skad du 'dri zhing / ci sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di/ rnam par thar pa brgyad la bslabs shing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ram zhes mchi na/ bcom ldan 'das de skad du 'dri ba de la ji skad du bstan par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das la la zhig 'di skad du 'dri zhing / ci sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu la bslabs shing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ram zhes mchi na/ bcom ldan 'das de skad du 'dri ba de la ji skad du bstan par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das la la zhig 'di skad du 'dri zhing / ci sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa myed pa la bslabs shing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa 15—484

nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ rnam pa thams ①cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ram zhes mchi ②na/ bcom ldan 'das de skad du 'dri ba de la ji skad du bstan par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das la la zhig 'di skad du du'adri zhing / ci sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di/ mngon par shes pa rnams la bslabs shing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ram zhes mchi na/ bcom ldan 'das de skad du 'dri ba de la ji skad du bstan par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das la la zhig 'di skad du 'dri zhing / ci sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di ting nge 'dzin rnams la bslabs shing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar bya'agyur ram/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ram zhes mchi na/ bcom ldan 'das de skad du 'dri ba de la ji skad du bstan par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das la la zhig 'di skad du 'dri zhing / ci sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams la bslabs shing ⑤/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ram zhes mchi na/ bcom ldan 'das de skad du 'dri ba de la ji skad du bstan par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das la la zhig 'di skad du 'dri zhing / ci sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu la bslabs shing ⑥/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ram zhes mchi na/ bcom ldan 'das de skad du 'dri ba de la ji skad du bstan par bgyi/bcom ldan 'das la la zhig 'di skad du 'dri zhing / ci sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di/mi 'jigs pa rnams la bslabs shing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 15—485

'byung bar 'gyur ram/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob ①par 'gyur ram zhes mchi na/ bcom ldan 'das de skad du 'dri ba de la ji skad du bstan par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das la la zhig 'di skad du 'dri zhing / ci sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di/ so so yang dag par rig pa rnams la bslabs shing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ram zhes mchi na/ bcom ldan 'das de skad du 'dri ba de la ji skad du bstan par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das la la zhig 'di skad du 'dri zhing / ci sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'dis/ snying rje chen po la bslabs shing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ram zhes mchi na/ bcom ldan 'das de skad du 'dri ba de la ji skad du bstan par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das la la zhig 'di skad du 'dri zhing / ci sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams la bslabs shing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ram/ zhes mchi na/ bcom ldan 'das de skad du 'dri ba de la ji skad du bstan par bgyi/de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rab 'byor de lta bas na/ de khyod nyid dul dris / khyod kyis ji ltar bzod pa de ltar lung ston cig /rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ gzugs kyang gzhan la sgyu ma yang gzhan zhig yin snyam mamadu/gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ⑥lta tshem lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ tshor ba yang gzhan la/15wa 486
