sgyu ma yang gzhan zhig yin snyam mam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de lta ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems / stobs rnams kyang gzhan la/ sgyu ma yang gzhan zhig yin snyam mam/gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de lta ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ byang chub kyi yan lag ①rnams kyang gzhan la/ sgyu ma yang gzhan zhig yin snyam mam/ gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das de lta ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ 'phags pa'i lam ②yan lag brgyad ②pa yang gzhan la/ sgyu ma yang gzhan zhig yin snyam mam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de lta ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyang gzhan la/sgyu ma yang gzhan zhig yin snyam mam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de lta ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems / bsam gtan rnams kyang gzhan la/ sgyu ma yang gzhan zhig yin snyam mam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de lta ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ tshad med pa rnams kyang gzhan la/ sgyu ma yang gzhan zhig yin snyam mam/ gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das de lta ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyang gzhan la/ sgyu ma yang gzhan zhig yin snyam mam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de lta ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 15—497

'byor de ji snyam du sems/ rnam par thar pa brgyad kyang gzhan la/ sgyu ma yang gzhan zhig yin snyam mam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de lta ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par ①'jug pa dgu yang gzhan la/sgyu ma yang gzhan zhig yin snyam mam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de lta ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang /smon pa med pa yang gzhan la/ sgyu ma yang gzhan zhig yin snyam mam/ gsol pa / bcom ldan 'das de lta ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ mngon par shes pa rnams kyang gzhan la/ sgyu ma yang gzhan zhig yin snyam mam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de lta ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ ting nge 'dzin rnams kyang gzhan la/ sgyu ma yang gzhan zhig yin snyam mam/ gsol pa/ zu bcom ldan 'das de lta ma lags so / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyang gzhan la/ sgyu ma yang gzhan zhig yin snyam mam/gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de lta ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams kyang gzhan la/ sgyu ma yang gzhan zhig yin snyam mam/ gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das de lta ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ mi 'jigs pa rnams kyang gzhan la/ sgyu ma 15—498

yang gzhan zhig yin snyam mam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de lta ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems / so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyang gzhan la/ sgyu ma yang gzhan zhig yin snyam mam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de lta ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/snying rje chen po yang gzhan la/ sgyu ma yang gzhan zhig yin snyam mam/ gsol pa / bcom ldan 'das de lta ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa ba'o brgyad kyang gzhan la/ sgyu ma yang gzhan zhig yin snyam mam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de lta ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ byang chub kyang gzhan la/ sgyu ma yang gzhan zhig yin snyam mam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de lta ma lags so// //hu7shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po bcu bdun ②pa/dubacom ldan 'das gzugs kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te④/gzugs nyid kyang sgyu ma sgyu ma nyid kyang gzugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das tshor ba yang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ tshor ba nyid kyang sgyu ma sgyu ma nyid kyang tshor ba'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'du ⑤shes kyang gzhan ma lags/sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te'u/ 'du shes nyid kyang sgyu ma sgyu ma nyid kyang 'du shes so/ /bcom ldan 'das 'du byed kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ 'du byed nyid kyang sgyu ma sgyu ma zhunyid kyang 'du byed dudo/ /bcom ldan 'das rnam par shes pa yang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma 15—499

lags te/ rnam par shes pa nyid kyang sgyu ma sgyu ma nyid kyang rnam par shes pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das mig kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/mig nyid ①kyang sgyu ma sgyu ma nyid kyang mig go/ /bcom ldan 'das rna ba yang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ rna ba nyid kyang sgyu ma sgyu ma nyid kyang rna ba'o/ /bcom ldan 'das sna yang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ sna nyid kyang sgyu ma sgyu ma nyid kyang sna'o/ /bcom ldan 'das lce yang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ lce nyid kyang sgyu ma sgyu ma nyid kyang lce'o/ /bcom ldan 'das lus kyang gzhan ma lags/sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ lus nyid kyang sgyu ma sgyu ma nyid kyang lus so/ /bcom ldan 'das yid kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/yid nyid kyang sgyu ma sgyu ma nyid kyang yid do/ /bcom ldan 'das gzugs kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ gzugs nyid kyang sgyu ma sgyu ma nyid kyang gzugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das sgra yang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ sgra nyid kyang sgyu ma sgyu ma nyid kyang sgra'o/ /bcom ldan 'das dri yang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ dri nyid kyang sgyu ma sgyu ma nyid kyang dri'o/ /bcom ldan 'das ro yang gzhan ma lags / sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ ro nyid kyang sgyu ma sgyu ma nyid kyang ro'ol/ /bcom ldan 'das reg kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ reg nyid kyang sgyu ma sgyu ma nyid kyang reg go/ /bcom ldan 'das chos (kyekyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ chos zhunyid kyang sgyu ma sgyu ma nyid kyang chos so/ /bcom ldan 'das mig gi rnam par shes pa yang 15—500

gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ mig gi rnam par shes pa nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang mig gi rnam par shes pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das rna ba'i rnam par shes pa yang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ rna ba'i rnam par shes pa nyid kyang sgyu ma sgyu ma nyid kyang rna ba'i rnam par shes pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das sna'i rnam par shes pa yang gzhan ma lags/sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ sna'i rnam par shes pa nyid kyang sgyu ma sgyu ma nyid kyang sna'i rnam par shes pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das lce'i rnam par shes pa yang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ lce'i rnam par shes pa nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang lce'i rnam par shes pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das lus kyi rnam par shes pa yang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/lus kyi rnam par shes pa nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang lus kyi rnam par shes pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das yid kyi rnam par shes pa yang gzhan ma lags/sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang yid kyi ①rnam par shes pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das mig gi 'dus te reg pa yang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ mig gi 'dus te reg pa nyid kyang sgyu ma sgyu ma nyid kyang mig gi 'dus te reg pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa yang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma ②yang gzhan ma lags te/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das sna'i 'dus te reg pa yang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa nyid kyang sgyu ma / sgyu ma nyid kyang sna'i 'dus te reg pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das lce'i 15—501

'dus te reg pa yang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang lce'i 'dus te reg pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das lus kyi 'dus te reg pa yang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das yid kyi 'dus te reg pa yang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das mig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis hu)tshor ba yang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ mig gi 'dus te reg pa'i larkyen kyis tshor ba nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang mig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'o/ /bcom ldan 'das rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang gzhan ma lags / sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'o/ /bcom ldan 'das sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'o/ /bcom ldan 'das lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'o/ /bcom ldan 'das lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ lus kyi 'dus 15—502

te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'o/ /bcom ldan 'das yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'o/ /bcom ldan 'das sa'i khams kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ sa'i khams nyid kyang sgyu ma/sgyu ma nyid kyang sa'i khams so/ /bcom ldan 'das chu'i khams kyang gzhan ma lags / sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ chu'i khams nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang chu'i khams so/ /bcom ldan 'das me'i khams kyang gzhan ma lags/sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ me'i khams nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang me'i khams so/ /bcom ldan 'das rlung gi khams kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ rlung gi khams nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang rlung gi khams so/ /bcom ldan 'das nam mkha'i khams kyang gzhan ma lags/sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ nam mkha'i khams nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang nam mkha'i khams so/ /bcom ldan 'das rnam par shes pa'i khams kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ rnam par shes pa'i khams nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang rnam par shes pa'i khams so/ /bcom ldan 'das ma rig pa yang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ ma rig pa nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang ma rig pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'du byed kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ 'du byed nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang 'du byed do/ /bcom ldan 'das rnam par 15—503

shes pa yang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ rnam par shes pa nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang rnam par shes pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das ming dang gzugs kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ming dang gzugs nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang ming dang gzugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das skye mched drug kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ skye mched drug nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang skye mched drug go/ /bcom ldan 'das reg pa yang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/reg pa nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang reg pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das tshor ba yang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ tshor ba nyid kyang sgyu ma / sgyu ma nyid kyang tshor ba'o/ /bcom ldan 'das sred pa yang gzhan ma lags / sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ sred pa nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang sred pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das len pa yang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang tshigazhan ma lags te/ len pa nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang len pa'o//bcom ldan 'das srid pa yang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/srid pa nyid kyang sgyu ma sgyu ma nyid kyang srid pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das skye ba yang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ skye ba nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang skye ba'o/ /bcom ldan 'das rga shi yang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ rga shi nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang rga shi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu 15—504

phyin pa yang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o / /bcom ldan 'das bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yang gzhan ma lags/sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa nyid kyang sgyu ma/sgyu ma nyid kyang bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o / /bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang gzhan ma lags/sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid kyang sgyu ma/sgyu ma nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das nang stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ nang stong pa nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang nang stong pa nyid do/ /bcom ldan 'das phyi stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ phyi stong pa nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang phyi stong pa nyid do/ /bcom ldan 'das phyi nang stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ phyi nang stong pa nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang phyi nang stong pa nyid do/ /bcom ldan 'das stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang stong pa nyid 15—505

stong pa nyid do/ /bcom ldan 'das chen po stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma lags/sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ chen po stong pa nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang chen po stong pa nyid do/ /bcom ldan 'das don dam pa stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ don dam pa stong pa nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang don dam pa stong pa nyid do/ /bcom ldan 'das 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/'dus byas stong pa nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang 'dus byas stong pa nyid do/ /bcom ldan 'das 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid do/ /bcom ldan 'das mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid ①do/ /bcom ldan 'das thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid do/ /bcom ldan 'das dor ba med pa stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ dor ba med pa stong pa nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang dor ba med pa stong pa nyid do/ /bcom ldan 'das rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags 15—506

te / chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang chos thams cad stong pa nyid do/ /bcom ldan 'das rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa ②nyid do/ /bcom ldan 'das mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid do/ /bcom ldan 'das dngos po med pa stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ dngos po med pa stong pa nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang dngos po med pa stong ②pa nyid do/ /bcom ldan 'das ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid do/ /bcom ldan 'das dngos po med pa'i ①ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid do/ /bcom ldan 'das dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams so/ /bcom ldan 'das yang dag par spong ba rnams kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ yang dag par spong ba nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang yang dag par spong ba rnams so/ /bcom ldan 'das rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa 15—507

nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams so/ /bcom ldan 'das dbang po rnams kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/dbang po nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang dbang po rnams so/ /bcom ldan 'das stobs rnams kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/stobs nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang stobs rnams so/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te / byang chub kyi yan lag nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang byang chub kyi yan lag rnams so/ /bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa yang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyang gzhan ma lags / sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ 'phags pa'i bden pa nyid kyang sgyu ma / sgyu ma nyid kyang 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams so/ /bcom ldan 'das bsam gtan rnams kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/bsam gtan nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang bsam gtan rnams so/ /bcom ldan 'das tshad med pa rnams kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ tshad med pa nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang tshad med pa rnams so/ /bcom ldan 'das gzugs med pa'i snyoms par ①'jug pa rnams kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams so/ /bcom ldan 'das rnam par thar pa brgyad kyang 15—508

gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ rnam par thar pa nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang rnam par thar pa rnams so/ /bcom ldan 'das mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyang ①gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa nyid kyang sgyu ma/sgyu ma nyid kyang mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams so/ /bcom ldan 'das rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang /smon pa med pa yang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang /mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das mngon par shes pa rnams kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang ②gzhan ma lags te/ mngon par shes pa nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang mngon par shes pa rnams so/ /bcom ldan 'das ting nge 'dzin rnams kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma kṣiṃ/gas te/ ting nge 'dzin nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang ting nge 'dzin rnams so/ /bcom ldan 'das gzungs ①kyi sgo rnams kyang gzhan ma lags/sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ gzungs kyi sgo nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang gzungs kyi sgo rnams so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs nyid 0kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams so/ /bcom ldan 'das mi 'jigs pa rnams kyang gzhan ma lags/sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ mi 'jigs pa nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid 15—509

kyang mi 'jigs pa rnams so/ /bcom ldan 'das so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ so so yang dag par rig pa nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang so so yang dag par rig pa rnams sol/ /bcom ldan 'das snying rje chen po yang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ snying rje chen po nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang snying rje chen po'o/ /bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams ①kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams sol/ /bcom ldan 'das rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu yang gzhan ma lags/sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu nyid kyang sgyu ma/sgyu ma nyid kyang rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu'o/ /bcom ldan 'das lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu yang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'o/ /bcom ldan 'das phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu yang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'o/ /bcom ldan 'das dgra bcom pa nyid kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te②/dgra bcom pa nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang dgra bcom pa nyid do/ /bcom ldan 'das rang byang chub kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ rang byang chub nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang rang byang chub bo/ /bcom ldan 'das lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang 15—510

gzhan ma lags te/ lam gyi rnam pa hu)shes pa nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid do/ /bcom ldan 'das rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid do / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/sgyu ma la skye ba'am 'gag pa yod dam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems / sgyu ma la kun nas nyon mongs pa'am rnam par byang ba yod dam/gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ gang la skye ba med cing 'gag pa med pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa med cing / rnam par byang ba med pa de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la slob par 'gyur ram/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ram/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni mi 'gyur ro / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga po 'di dag la 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya bar 'du shes kladang / brda dang / gdags pa dang / tha snyad du bya ba yin nam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de lta ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ 'du shes chadang / brda dang / gdags pa dang / tha snyad tsam gyis nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga po skye ba'am 'gag pa'am kun nas nyon mongs pa'am/ rnam 15—511

par byang bar dmigs par 'gyur ram/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni mi 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ gang la 'du shes med cing brda med pa dang / gdags pa med pa dang / tha snyad med pa dang / ming med pa dang / ming du gdags pa med pa dang / lus med pa dang / lus kyi las med pa dang / ngag med pa dang / ngag gi las med pa dang / yid med pa dang / yid kyi las med pa dang / skye ba med pa dang / 'gag pa med pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa med pa dang / rnam par byang ba med pa de ①shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bslabs shing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ram/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni mi 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bslabs shing / myi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung ngo / /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur rol/ /gsol pa bcom ldan 'das kyis ji skad du gsungs pa'i don bdag gis 'tshal te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos ni/ sgyu ma'i skyes bus bslabs ②pa ltar/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bslab par bgyi'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na / bcom ldan 'das de ni 'di lta ste/ phung po lnga po 'di gnyid sgyu ma'i skyes bur rig par bgyi ba sha stag go/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ phung po lnga po 'di dag shes rab kyi pha rol tu 15—512

phyin ①pa la bslabs ②shing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni mi 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das de ②'di ltar phung po lnga po rnams ni dngos po ma mchis pa'i rang bzhin te/ dngos po ma mchis pa'i rang bzhin de ni dmigs su ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ rmi lam lta bu'i phung po lnga po de dag shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bslabs shing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni mi 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das de ④'di ltar mi lam ni dngos po ma mchis pa'i rang bzhin te/ dngos po ma mchis pa'i rang bzhin de ni dmigs su ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ sgyu ma lta bu'i phung po lnga po de dag shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bslabs shing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni mi 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/bcom ldan 'das de du'adi ltar sgyu ma ni dngos po ma mchis pa'i rang bzhin te/dngos po ma mchis pa'i rang bzhin de ni dmigs su ma mchis so bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ sgra brnyan lta bu'i phung po lnga po de dag shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bslabs shing /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das de ni mi 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das de du'adi ltar sgra brnyan ⑦ni/ dngos po ma mchis pa'i rang bzhin te/15—513

dngos po ma mchis pa'i rang bzhin de ni dmigs su ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ mig yor lta bu'i phung po lnga po de dag shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bslabs shing /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das de ni mi 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das de ①'di ltar mig yor ⑤ni dngos po ma mchis pa'i rang bzhin te/dngos po ma mchis pa'i rang bzhin de ni dmigs su ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ chu zla lta bu'i phung po lnga po de dag /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bslabs shing /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das de ni mi 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das de ②'di ltar chu zla ni dngos po ma mchis pa'i rang bzhin te/ dngos po ma mchis pa'i rang bzhin de ni dmigs su ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ smig rgyu lta bu'i phung po lnga po de dag shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bslabs shing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni mi 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das de ④'di dultar smig rgyu ni dngos po ma mchis pa'i rang bzhin te/ dngos po ma mchis pa'i rang bzhin de ni dmigs su ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ sprul pa lta bu'i phung po lnga po de dag shes rab kyi 96༄pha rol tu phyin pa la bslabs shing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 15—514

'byung bar 'gyur ram gsol pa bcom ldan 'das de ni mi 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das de ①'di ltar sprul pa ni dngos po ma mchis pa'i rang bzhin te/ dngos po ma mchis pa'i rang bzhin de ni dmigs su ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ni 'di ltar gzugs ni rmi lam lta bu/ tshor ba ni rmi lam lta bu/ 'du shes ni rmi lam lta bu/ 'du byed ni rmi lam lta bu/ rnam par shes pa ni rmi lam lta bu ste/ rnam par shes pa gang yin pa de ni dbang po drug go/ /de ni phung po lnga'o/ /de dag ni nang stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmigs so/ /phyi stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmigs sol/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmigs so/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmigs so/ /chen po stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmigs so/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir myi dmigs so/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmigs so/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmigs so/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmigs so/ /thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmigs so/ /dor ba med pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmigs sol/ /②rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmigs so/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmigs so/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmigs so/ /mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmigs so/ /dngos po med pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmigs so/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmigs so / /dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor gzugs ni sgyu ma lta bu/ tshor ba ni sgyu ma lta bu/ 'du shes ni sgyu ma lta bu/'du byed ni sgyu ma lta bu/ rnam par shes pa ni sgyu ma lta bu ste(kye/ rnam par shes 15—515

pa gang yin pa de ni dbang po drug go/ /de ni phung po lnga'o/ /de dag ni nang stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmigs so/ /phyi stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmigs so/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmigs so/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmigs so/ /chen po stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmigs so/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmigs so/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmigs so/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmigs so/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmigs so/ /thog ①ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmigs so/ /dor ba med pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmigs so/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmigs so/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmigs so/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmigs so/ /mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmigs so/ /dngos po med pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmigs so/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmigs so/ /dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor gzugs ni sgra brnyan lta bu/ tshor ba ni sgra brnyan lta bu/ 'du shes ni sgra brnyan lta bu/ 'du byed ni sgra brnyan lta bu/ rnam par shes pa ni sgra brnyan lta bu ste/ rnam par shes pa gang yin pa de ni dbang po drug go/ /de ni phung po lnga'o / /de dag ni nang stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmigs so/ /phyi stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmyigs so/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid kyi phyir myi dmigs so/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir myi dmigs so/ /chen po stong pa nyid kyi phyir myi dmigs so/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir myi dmyigs so/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmigs so/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyi phyir myi 15—516

dmyigs so/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmyigs so/ /thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmigs so/ /dor ba med pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir myi dmigs so/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmyigs so/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmigs so/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir myi dmigs so/ /mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmyigs so/ /dngos po med pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir myi dmigs so/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmyigs so/ /dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor gzugs ni myig yor lta bu/ tshor ba ni myig yor lta bu / 'du shes ni myig yor lta bu/ 'du byed ni mig yor lta bu/ rnam par shes pa ni myig yor lta bu ste/ rnam par shes pa gang yin pa de ni dbang po drug go/ /de ni phung po lnga'o/ /de dag ni nang stong pa nyid kyi phyir myi dmyigs sol/ /phyi stong pa nyid kyi phyir myi dmyigs so/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid kyi phyir myi dmyigs so/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir myi dmyigs so/ /chen po stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmigs so/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmyigs so//'dus byas stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmigs so/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmigs so/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmigs so/ /thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmigs so/ /dor ba med pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmigs so/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmigs so/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmigs so/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmigs so/ /mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmigs so/ /dngos po med pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmigs so/ /ngo bo 15—517

phyir mi dmigs so/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmigs so/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmigs so/ /mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir ①mi dmigs so/ /dngos po med pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmigs so/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmigs so/ /dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir mi dmigs so/ /chalagasol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de lta lags na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa la gsar du zhugs pas/ bstan pa 'di thos na②/ 'jigs shing sngang ④ba dang / skrag par mi 'gyur lags grang ⑤/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor gal te byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ theg pa la gsar du zhugs pa yang yin la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la thabs kyang mi mkhas pa zhig ste/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi lag tu yang ma 'ongs na/ 'jigs dushing sngang ⑦ba dang / skrag par yang me'agyur ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bstan pa 'di thos na / mi 'jigs mi sngang ⑨/ mi skrag pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la thabs mkhas pa de gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang /ldan pa'i sems kyis/ gzugs mi rtag ces bya bar rtog ste(nye/ de tunyemi dmigs so/ / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems kyis/⑫tshor ba mi rtag ces bya bar rtog ste'u/ de 8mi dmigs so/ / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems kyis/tunye 'du shes mi rtag ces bya 15—520

shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/① bam po brtswa brgyad ②pa/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ltar rtog ①pa de 'di snyam du sems teX/ sems can thams cad la gzugs myi rtag ces bya bar de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis chos bstan to/ /gzugs sdug bsngal zhes bya bar de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis chos bstan to/ /gzugs bdag med ces bya bar de myi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis chos bstan to/ /gzugs zhi zhes bya bar de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis chos bstan to/ /gzugs stong zhes bya bar de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis chos bstan to/ /gzugs mtshan ma med ces bya bar de mi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis chos bstan to/ /gzugs smon pa myed ces bya bar de myi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis chos bstan to/ /gzugs mngon par 'du bya dub med ces bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis chos bstan to/ /gzugs dben zhes bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis chos bstan to/ /tshor ba mi rtag ces bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis chos bstan to/ /tshor ba sdug bsngal zhes bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis chos bstan to/ /tshor ba bdag med ces bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis chos bstan to/ /tshor ba zhi zhes bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis chos bstan to/ /tshor ba stong zhes bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis chos bstan to/ /tshor ba mtshan ma myed ces bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis chos bstan to/ /tshor ba smon pa med ces bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis chos bstan to/ /tshor ba mngon par 'du bya ba med ces bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis chos bstan to/ /tshor ba dben zhes bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis chos bstan to/ /'du shes mi rtag ces bya bar de mi 15—531

pa'i tshul gyis yid la byed do/ /nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi yid la bya ba dang mi ldan pas/ rnam par shes pa gang dben pa'i rnam par yid la byed pa de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis yid la byed do/ /rab 'byor 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyams pa med pa ste/de yod pas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de mi 'jigs mi sngang ①skrag par mi 'gyur ro/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ chos de dag la mi rtag pa'i rnam pa dang / sdug bsngal ba'i rnam pa dang / bdag med pa'i rnam pa dang / zhi ba'i rnam pa dang / stong pa nyid kyi rnam pa dang / mtshan ma med pa'i rnam pa dang / smon pa med pa'i rnam pa dang / mngon par 'du bya ba med pa'i rnam pa dang / dben pa'i rnam par rtogs par byed pa dang /bzod pa dang / mos pa 'di ni rab 'byor ②byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ste/ de yod pas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ②mi 'jigs mi sngang duskrag par mi 'gyur ro/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ gzugs mi rtag ces bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rab tu rtog go/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/gzugs sdug bsngal zhes bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rab tu rtog go/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ gzugs bdag med ces bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rab tu rtog go/ /rnam pa 15—538

thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ gzugs zhi zhes bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rab tu rtog go/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ gzugs stong ①zhes bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rab tu rtog go/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ gzugs mtshan ma med ces bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rab tu rtog go/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ gzugs smon pa med ces bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rab tu rtog go/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/gzugs mngon par 'du bya ba med ces bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rab tu rtog go/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/gzugs dben zhes bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rab tu rtog go/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ tshor ba mi rtag ces bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rab tu rtog go/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas tshor ba sdug bsngal zhes bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rab tu rtog go/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas tshor ba bdag med ces bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rab tu rtog go/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas tshor ba zhi zhes bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rab tu rtog go/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ tshor ba stong zhes bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rab tu rtog go/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ tshor ba mtshan ma med ces bya 15—539

bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rab tu rtog go/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/① tshor ba smon pa med ces bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rab tu rtog go/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ tshor ba mngon par 'du bya ba med ces bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rab tu rtog go/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ tshor ba dben zhes bya bar de mi ②dmigs ⑧pa'i tshul gyis rab tu rtog go/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ 'du shes mi rtag ces bya bar de mi (pedamigs pa'i tshul gyis rab tu rtog go/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/'du shes sdug bsngal zhes bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rab tu rtog go/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ 'du shes bdag med ces bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rab tu rtog go/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ 'du shes zhi zhes bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rab tu rtog go/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ 'du shes stong zhes bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rab tu rtog go/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ 'du shes mtshan ma med ces bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rab tu rtog go/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ 'du shes smon pa med ces bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rab tu rtog go/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/'du shes mngon par 'du bya ba med ces bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rab 15—540

tu rtog go/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/'du shes dben zhes bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rab tu rtog go/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ 'du byed mi rtag ces bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rab tu rtog go/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ 'du byed sdug bsngal zhes bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rab tu rtog go/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ 'du byed bdag med ces bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rab tu rtog go/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ 'du byed zhi zhes bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rab tu rtog go/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/'du byed stong zhes bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rab tu rtog go/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid ①la bya bas/ 'du byed mtshan ma med ces bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rab tu rtog go/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ 'du byed smon pa med ces bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rab tu rtog go/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ 'du byed mngon par 'du bya ba med ces bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rab tu rtog go/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ 'du byed dben zhes bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rab tu rtog go/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ rnam par shes pa mi rtag ces bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rab tu rtog go/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang 15—541

ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ rnam par shes pa sdug bsngal zhes bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rab tu rtog go/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ rnam par shes pa bdag med ces bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rab tu rtog go/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ rnam par shes pa zhi zhes bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rab tu rtog go/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ rnam par shes pa stong zhes bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rab tu rtog go/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/rnam par shes pa mtshan ma med ces bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rab tu rtog go/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/rnam par shes pa smon pa med ces bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rab tu rtog go/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/rnam par shes pa mngon par 'du bya ba med ces bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rab tu rtog go/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ rnam par shes pa dben zhes bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rab tu rtog go/ /de ltar de de dag la rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ mi gtong zhing brtson 'grus mi 'dor ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de'i brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste/de yod pas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de mi 'jigs mi sngang ①skrag par mi 'gyur ro/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ nam ②rnam pa 15—542

thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ gzugs mi rtag ces bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rtog cing / nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba dang / sgomi dge ba'i ①chos ②de ma yin pa byang chub kyi bgegs dusu 'gyur ba gzhan gyis skyiskabs mi 'byed pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/nam rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ gzugs sdug bsngal zhes bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rtog cing / nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba dang tshe'u/ mi dge ba de ma yin pa byang chub kyi bgegs su 'gyur ba gzhan gyis 'ugo mi 'byed pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la 〉spyod pa'i tshe / nam rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/gzugs bdag med ces dubya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rtog cing /nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba dang / mi dge ba de ma yin pa byang chub kyi bgegs su 'gyur ba gzhan gyis spugo mi 'byed pa dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ nam rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/⑩ gzugs zhi zhes bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rtog cing / nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba dang / mi dge ba de ma yin pa byang chub kyi bgegs su 'gyur ba gzhan gyis go mi 'byed tsuskrepa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/nam rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ gzugs 15—543
